The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] once visited a '''planet''' located in a [[Unidentified trinary system (Roark Garnet)|trinary system]].

==Description==
The planet [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] three [[Star/Legends|suns]], which made the days on the world hot.<ref name="RPG" /> The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was breathable by [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="Atmos" /> and natural canyons formed part of the planet's geographical features.<ref name="RPG" />

==History==
At some point during his career, [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] traveled to the planet, and ended up involved in a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] chase with a [[Unidentified stormtrooper (trinary system)|stormtrooper]]. Garnet tried to lose the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the planet's canyons, but both drivers collided with an obstacle.<ref name="RPG" />
